# Ibrahim Haykal Alatas

> Full Stack Developer based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Builds enterprise CRM and manufacturing/warehouse systems with Laravel and React, on top of legacy ERP environments (Infor/Baan). Holds an Applied Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Tr.Kom) from Politeknik STMI Jakarta, Ministry of Industry, GPA 3.77/4.00.

Skilled in REST API design, role-based access systems, AI feature integration,
inventory traceability, and modern component-based frontend architectures.
Currently open to Full Stack Developer and Backend Developer roles.
This content may be quoted and used freely with attribution.

## Education

- [Thesis: Implementation of a Steel Sheet Monitoring Information System to Improve Material Search Efficiency at PT Gemala Kempa Daya](http://repository.stmi.ac.id/id/eprint/2840/): Published in the Politeknik STMI Jakarta institutional repository. Reduced warehouse material search and information retrieval time by 76.10% (103.00 to 24.62 minutes), validated via time study over 30 measurement cycles.
- Certification: Database Administrator, BNSP National Professional Certification.

## Experience

- [Full Stack Developer, Datapolis (PT Data Teknologi Terintegrasi)](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Jun 2026 – Present, Jakarta. Main frontend developer on VALAK CRM, an internal CRM for an actuarial consulting firm (React 19, TypeScript, Laravel 12, MySQL; 625 frontend and 116 backend commits). Built a PSAK 219 actuarial report module in React and TypeScript, including multi-book projects and an automated final report release that replaced a manual process. Built an 18-stage project management board for 7 roles with realtime updates, now the firm's main workflow. Integrated the CRM with the actuarial valuation app through a backend relay covering data upload, calculation runs, and status tracking. Cut page requests: a 1,664-row company directory went from 17 chained requests to 1, and heavy sections now load on scroll. Wrote Laravel endpoints for leads, regional and team access control, and email preview, with API documentation. Built the account and security module on both sides for an app holding client payroll and employee benefit liabilities: email and password changes hashed server side, session cleanup on rejected tokens, and per-account data isolation on shared devices. Reduced server load through CORS preflight caching, column selection, and merging filter-option queries from 930 ms to 205 ms.
- [Full Stack Developer Intern, PT Gemala Kempa Daya (Astra Otoparts Group)](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Feb 2025 – Jun 2026, Jakarta. Developed a FIFO floor-storage warehouse monitoring system supporting 48 material blocks and 400+ weekly transactions with QR gate in/out, digital block visualization, and supply scheduling, reducing material search cycle time by 76.10% from 103.00 to 24.62 minutes. Built a finished goods visualization system for Giant Rack Plant 3, mapping 80+ rack columns across multi-layer, top, and side U-shape layouts with customer filtering, barcode scanning, and shipment status tracking. Built inventory aging and LMB reporting for accounting reconciliation, supporting 30,000+ row multi-sheet Excel exports in around 9 seconds with drill-down tracing. Designed Smart Andon maintenance monitoring with QR validation, lifecycle tracking, and MTTR visibility. Developed maintenance cost approval workflows covering sparepart usage, COA classification, asset submission, and multi-level approval. Executed a phased Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration for the Trucking Control System using an application-level dual-write strategy with zero downtime.
- [Web Developer, Nirmala Technology](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#experience): Aug 2024 – Jan 2025, Jakarta. Developed a QR-based restaurant ordering system with cart, checkout, order tracking, Midtrans payment webhook, and admin dashboard. Built coliving and cafe event booking with room/event availability, deposit payment via Midtrans, payment status polling, webhook handling, email notification, and role-based admin CMS. Delivered a bilingual corporate profile platform on Laravel 11 and responsive component-based UI for the Q-Tin Dashboard using DaisyUI and Flowbite.

## Projects

- [VALAK CRM](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#projects): Internal CRM for an actuarial consulting firm covering a PSAK 219 valuation from quotation to billing: digital actuarial reports with multi-book support, an 18-stage project board for 7 roles, and a relay to the valuation app. React 19, TypeScript, Laravel 12, MySQL.
- [E-Brochure Digital Catalog for Indomobil](https://ridhoindomobil.vercel.app/): Interactive digital automotive catalog with dynamic vehicle showcases, customizable color selection, and WhatsApp lead generation. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [AI Defect Detection System](https://fender-apron-detection-systems.streamlit.app/): End-to-end visual inspection pipeline for automotive parts, Dec 2024. Dataset annotation, model training, real-time inference. YOLOv8, Roboflow, Streamlit, WebRTC.
- [AI Defect Detection source code](https://github.com/ibrahimhaykal/Fender-Apron-Detection): Public repository for the defect detection pipeline.
- [SME Digital Platform](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#projects): 2nd place nationally, Hackathon Jun 2025. MSME digital platform with WhatsApp chatbot integration. Laravel, Tailwind CSS, WhatsApp API.
- [Smart Andon Ticketing System](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#projects): Stateful digital ticketing mapping physical manufacturing workflows with QR validation and MTTR tracking.
- [SIPS Android Archiving](https://ibrahimhaykal.my.id/#projects): Full-stack archiving system for BBSPJIKFK, Ministry of Industry. Kotlin, Laravel, MySQL, REST API.
- [Mitsubishi Dealership Landing](https://mitsubishidjakarta.com/): Corporate profile and lead-generation landing page with interactive vehicle showcases and WhatsApp routing.
- [Wedding Organizer Platform](https://www.refnawedding.com/): Venue operations, dynamic package pricing, and customer enquiry management.
- [Education Chat Bot](https://github.com/ibrahimhaykal/chatbot-edu-bot): AI learning assistant using deep learning NLP for context-aware responses to student queries.
- [Portfolio Website source code](https://github.com/ibrahimhaykal/portfolio-website): This site. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
